CustomField.complianceGroup: Source - Salesforce;Privacy - Non Personal Information;Integrity - Accurate
CustomField.description: System generated field for CMOS Complaints to record the status of DEH Status based on the values of its dependent date fields
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISBLANK( IDR_DEH_Date_information_request_sent__c ), ISBLANK( IDR_DEH_Date_information_received__c ) ), 'New Complaint', IF( AND( ISBLANK(IDR_DEH_Date_information_received__c ), TODAY() > IDR_DEH_Date_information_due__c ), 'No information received - prepare response', IF( ISBLANK(IDR_DEH_Date_information_received__c), 'Request for further information sent', IF(IDR_DEH_Date_information_received__c > IDR_DEH_Date_information_due__c, 'Information received after due date - prepare response', 'Information received - prepare response') ) ) )
CustomField.label: DEH Current Status
